title: 1 烂透了的世道2 怒而杀人越杀越强
content_zh:
曹笔蹲在墙角，看着天上的月亮。
穿越三年了。
他早就接受了这个事实——回不去了。
前世的记忆越来越模糊，只剩下一些碎片：高楼、手机、还有那个永远加不完的班。
现在他是个流民，藏在枯苓村废弃的土坯房里，靠挖野菜、抓田鼠，抠泥鳅那些活着。
这世道不好。
他听村里老人说，北边在打仗，南边也在打仗。
当官的今天收税，明天征兵。
枯苓村原本有三十几户，现在只剩下七八户老弱。
“小曹，还不睡？”
说话的是隔壁的王老汉，六十多了，儿子被抓去当兵，再也没回来。
曹笔笑笑：“睡不着。”
他当然睡不着！
三年了，他一直在想一个问题：既然穿越这种事情都成真了，为何自己没有一点特殊之处呢？
不奢望系统什么的，哪怕给个每天一碗白粥的能力也行啊。
这世道，饿肚子是真的度日如年。
三年里，他曾用过很多种方式，试图找到可能存在的金手指，可惜……最终都功亏一篑。
时间与生活的残酷，让他不得不承认，自己虽然穿越了，可依旧是一个普通人！
甚至，在这吃人的世道里，比普通人还不如。
因为他还留着前世的道德与三观。

村里老人都说他是心善，可这世道，心善是最没用的东西。
他曾亲眼见证心善的人被两匹马活活拖死，被裹了铁皮的乱棍打死，被吊在树上生生饿死……那些凶手猖狂的笑声，他至今忘不了。
“哒哒哒~哒哒哒~~”
远处突然传来马蹄声，在深夜尤为清晰。
曹笔耳朵一动，立马起身趴上墙头往外看。
火把，刀，马匹！
“溃兵！”
他脑子里炸开，赶紧喊道：“王大爷！快躲起来！”
可是来不及了。
村子不大，那些士兵又骑着马，从听到声音，到冲进村庄，就几个呼吸的时间。
那些溃兵冲进村子，见房就烧，见人就砍，惨叫声、哭喊声、马蹄声混成一片。
曹笔拼命往后山跑，跑出几十步，他回头看了一眼。
刚好看见王老汉被两个溃兵从屋里拖出来，一刀捅进肚子，在清冷的月光下尤为刺眼。
“这群畜生！！！”
曹笔恨极了，但他无能为力，只能咬紧牙关，转身继续跑。
他不能停，停下来就是死。
他不是第一回经历这种事了，知道这些溃兵是没有任何人性的。
他们在战场上受了气，吓破了胆，就会逃到后方，通过虐杀手无寸铁的妇孺老弱来发泄，不分昼夜。
……
曹笔在山上躲了一夜。
content_en:
Cao Bi squatted in the corner and looked at the moon in the sky.
Three years have passed.
He had long accepted the fact that there was no going back.
The memories of my past life are getting blurry, leaving only a few fragments: tall buildings, mobile phones, and that endless overtime class.
Now he is a refugee, hiding in an abandoned adobe house in Kuling Village, surviving by digging wild vegetables, catching voles, and digging out loaches.
The world is not good.
He heard from the elders in the village that there was a war in the north and a war in the south.
Officials collect taxes today and recruit soldiers tomorrow.
There were originally more than thirty households in Kuling Village, but now there are only seven or eight old and weak households left.
"Xiao Cao, are you still not sleeping?"
The speaker was Old Man Wang next door. He was over sixty years old. His son was arrested and sent to serve as a soldier and never came back.
Cao Bi smiled: "Can't sleep."
Of course he couldn't sleep!
For three years, he has been thinking about a question: Since time travel has become a reality, why is there nothing special about him?
Don't expect anything from the system, even if you can give me the ability to have a bowl of porridge every day.
In this world, hungry people really live like years.
In the past three years, he has used many methods to try to find the possible golden finger, but unfortunately... all failed in the end.
The cruelty of time and life forced him to admit that although he had traveled through time, he was still an ordinary person!
Even, in this world of cannibalism, he is worse than ordinary people.
Because he still retains the morality and three views of his previous life.
The elders in the village all said that he had a kind heart, but in this world, a kind heart is the most useless thing.
He had witnessed with his own eyes a kind-hearted person being dragged to death by two horses, beaten to death with iron-wrapped sticks, and hung on a tree to starve to death... He could never forget the rampant laughter of those murderers.
"Da da da~ da da da~~"
The sound of horse hooves suddenly sounded in the distance, which was especially clear late at night.
Cao Bi's ears twitched, and he immediately stood up and leaned on the wall to look out.
Torches, knives, horses!
"Broken troops!"
His mind exploded and he quickly shouted: "Uncle Wang! Hide quickly!"
But it was too late.
The village was not big, and the soldiers were riding horses. From hearing the sound to rushing into the village, it only took a few breaths.
The defeated soldiers rushed into the village, burning houses and cutting down people when they saw them. The screams, cries, and the sound of horse hooves were all mixed together.
Cao Bi ran as hard as he could toward the back hill. After running dozens of steps, he looked back.
I just happened to see Old Man Wang being dragged out of the house by two defeated soldiers and stabbed in the stomach with a knife, which was particularly dazzling under the cold moonlight.
"These beasts!!!"
Cao Bi was filled with hatred, but there was nothing he could do. He could only grit his teeth, turn around and continue running.
He couldn't stop, he would die if he stopped.
This was not the first time he had experienced this kind of thing, and he knew that these defeated soldiers had no humanity at all.
When they are angry and frightened on the battlefield, they will flee to the rear and vent their anger by torturing defenseless women, children, the elderly and the weak, day and night.
…
Cao Bi hid in the mountains all night.
